about: 4K Mania's Training pack: ten stages from about 2 to 7 stars (osu!mania's star rating), three maps a stage. Built by tools/native/mania_pack.cpp from tools/mania/maps.json.

maps.title: Chiptune Speedway
maps.about: Half-beat runs and jumps on the beat: keep a steady pace with both hands.

maps.title: Midnight Stomp
maps.about: Jumps on the kick and snare: two keys landing together, cleanly.

maps.title: Hover Pit
maps.about: Your first holds: keep one finger down while the other hand taps.

maps.title: Diabolical Maneuvers
maps.about: Half-beat runs, jumps on the beat and short quarter-beat bursts, at 160.

maps.title: Thunder on the Floor
maps.about: Jumps on every hit: read which two keys come next.

maps.title: Basic Wobblefest
maps.about: Rolls and trills: fingers in order, evenly.

maps.title: Breaking Back into the Wubs
maps.about: Quarter-beat streams with breathers: stamina starts here.

maps.title: Running Rage
maps.about: Light jumpstream and three-key hands on the big hits.

maps.title: Back to the Grime
maps.about: Trills, rolls and an anchored finger (runningman).

maps.title: Spiral Flight
maps.about: Jumpstream at 160: jumps inside a constant stream.

maps.title: Shattered Bass
maps.about: Chords that repeat a key (minijacks): hit the same key twice, fast.

maps.title: Pixel Warrior
maps.about: Split trills: each hand trills its own keys, with holds under the stream.

maps.title: Racket and Bang
maps.about: Full jumpstream and the first handstream.

maps.title: War Horse
maps.about: Chordjacks at half-beat: chords sharing keys, the heavy metal way.

maps.title: The Freakazoid Race
maps.about: Jumptrills, split trills and runningmen in a race.

maps.title: Final Lap
maps.about: Handstream at 160: three keys inside the stream.

maps.title: Brutal Sines
maps.about: Chordjacks with hands: keep the chords clean when keys repeat.

maps.title: Up For a Race
maps.about: Inverse: every gap a hold. Read where to let go.
